# Antigravity-Inspired Interactive Portfolio & Showreel Platform

Design and build an ultra-premium, futuristic developer portfolio inspired by the **Google Antigravity** official aesthetic. The portfolio combines deep-space cyberpunk visual design, dynamic WebGL particle physics, an interactive **Keynote Showreel & Presentation Mode** with video-like scrubbing, an interactive **Zero-G Physics Playground**, live project simulators, an embedded Antigravity CLI terminal, and procedural Web Audio soundscapes.

---

## 🌟 Core Inspirations & Key Features

1. **Antigravity Visual & Physics Universe**:
   - Deep obsidian space palette (`#06080e`, `#0a0e1a`, `#00f0ff`, `#7c3aed`, `#10b981`).
   - WebGL / Three.js quantum particle field with dynamic gravity well, mouse velocity attraction/repulsion, and focal bloom.
   - **Zero-Gravity Mode Toggle**: Flip the page into zero-g physics where project badges, tech shards, and cards float and can be tossed across the screen.

2. **Cinematic Keynote & Video Showreel Deck**:
   - An interactive, video-like presentation deck complete with play/pause, timeline scrubber, chapter navigation, dynamic slide animations, narration transcripts, and live interactive demo embeds.
   - Showcases the developer's core vision, distributed systems, mesh networks, game engines, and AI integrations.

3. **Interactive Project Nexus (With Live In-Card Simulators)**:
   - **MeshTalk Native**: Interactive decentralized node topology simulator (broadcast packets between offline nodes).
   - **Zedox Rarity Core**: Interactive live RNG roller and probability curve visualizer.
   - **Cloud Sentinel & Infra**: Live DDoS mitigation and server telemetry ping simulator.
   - 3D holographic tilt effects, live modal drill-downs, and source links.

4. **Embedded Antigravity CLI Terminal**:
   - Interactive terminal emulator supporting commands like `help`, `skills`, `projects`, `showreel`, `zerog`, `matrix`, `clear`, `contact`, and audio beeps.

5. **Procedural Web Audio Engine**:
   - Built-in lightweight sound synthesizer using Web Audio API for futuristic UI hover clicks, laser sweeps, gravity hums, and modal transitions (with instant mute/unmute control).

---

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Audio & Animation Intensity**: The portfolio will include ambient sound effects (Web Audio API) which default to muted or opt-in with a glowing audio visualizer button in the header.
>
> **Workspace**: We will upgrade the portfolio in `C:\Users\EI\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\zedox-portfolio` (or create a clean preview build in it).

- Run `npm run build` or `npm run dev` in `C:\Users\EI\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\zedox-portfolio` to verify zero compile or lint errors.

  6. Zero-G physics sandbox drag and fling interactions.
  7. Full responsiveness across mobile, tablet, and widescreen viewports.

# Antigravity-Inspired Interactive Portfolio & Showreel Platform

The new portfolio web application inspired by **Google Antigravity** has been built and verified. It incorporates deep space cyber aesthetics, real-time WebGL particle physics, an interactive **Keynote Showreel & Presentation Player**, live project simulators, an embedded Antigravity CLI terminal, and procedural Web Audio soundscapes.

---

## 🚀 Key Modules Built

### 1. Dynamic 3D WebGL Antigravity Canvas
- **Dynamic Particle Vortex**: Over 2,000 quantum particles reacting to cursor gravity and mouse velocity.
- **Glowing Celestial Core**: Dual icosahedron & dodecahedron wireframe center with rotating orbital rings and camera tilt.
- **Zero-Gravity Mode**: Toggleable zero-g state that accelerates particle dispersion into a cosmic drift.

### 2. Cinematic Keynote & Video Showreel Deck
- **Video-Style Keynote Deck**: 5 interactive slide stages covering *Vision*, *MeshTalk P2P*, *Zedox Rarity RNG*, *Edge Infra*, and *Next Horizons*.
- **Interactive Scrubber**: Timeline progress bar with play/pause, keyboard navigation (Arrow keys / Space), narration notes toggle, and fullscreen mode.
- **Live Code & Architecture Previews**: Interactive snippet inspection on every slide.

### 3. Interactive In-Card Project Simulators
- **MeshTalk Native**: Interactive mesh visualizer where clicking *Broadcast Test Packet* triggers multi-hop packet routing across simulated relay nodes in real time.
- **Zedox Rarity Core**: Interactive PRNG roll machine with real-time loot drops, pity rates, and celebratory confetti + audio chimes on mythic/legendary drops.
- **Cloud Sentinel & Edge Infra**: Server cluster telemetry with live ping test and a 10Gbps DDoS flood deflection simulator.

### 4. Zero-Gravity Physics Sandbox
- **Interactive Canvas Physics**: Tossable technology modules and badges with velocity, collision detection, and elastic wall bounces.
- **Gravity Field Switcher**: Switch between **Zero-G Mode** (modules float and drift) and **Earth Gravity** (modules drop and bounce).

### 5. Antigravity CLI Terminal Emulator
- **Functional Developer Shell**: Type commands such as `help`, `whoami`, `projects`, `showreel`, `zerog`, `skills`, `roll`, `ping`, `matrix`, `contact`, `clear`.
- **Interactive Shell Features**: Command history navigation (Up/Down arrow keys), typing sound effects, and direct UI triggers.

### 6. Procedural Web Audio Engine
- **Pure Web Audio API**: Procedural sound generation without heavy audio files.
- Generates hover blips, cyber clicks, laser sweeps, gravity whoosh, terminal keystrokes, and jackpot fanfares.
- Features a floating audio visualizer toggle in the header.

---

## 🛠️ Verification & Dev Server

- **Build Verification**: `npm run build` completed with zero errors in `5.14s`.
- **Local Dev Server**: Active at [http://localhost:5173/zedox-portfolio/](http://localhost:5173/zedox-portfolio/)
- **Configuration & Content**: All bio, projects, slides, and stats can be edited in [portfolioData.js](file:///C:/Users/EI/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/zedox-portfolio/src/data/portfolioData.js).

# GitHub Pages Deployment Workflow
name: Deploy to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main", "master"]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v4

      - name: Upload artifact
